name: Heart with Teeth
source:
There it is! The monster! 

You finally caught up with it. You finally see it in front of you, and there is only one thing left to do. But what if... what if there is more to the monster's story? Something is not right.

If he were only willing to let you in...

[From [url=https://slightlysaneee.itch.io/heart-with-teeth]itch.io[/url]]
